birth.segment: Pay Ubre: the Countryside That Becomes Mercedes
birth.stop: Pay Ubre, the birth in the camp
birth.date_confidence: traditional and disputed. English Wikipedia gives '1840s, allegedly 1847'; Spanish Wikipedia gives only 'alrededor de 1840' and carries no birth date in its infobox at all. The widely circulated precise date of 12 August 1847 appears in neither and has no located source. No baptismal record is cited anywhere. Some historical commentary holds the figure may be a composite of several Correntino deserters rather than one man; the register of this file takes him as one man.
